ex.en: Climate change is causing more extreme weather.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷造成越來越多的極端天氣。

ex.en: Governments must act quickly on climate change.
ex.zh: 各國政府必須盡快因應氣候變遷。

climate change.en: the way the world's weather is slowly changing, especially getting warmer

ex.en: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
ex.zh: 鮑伯星期六在雜貨店當店員。

ex.en: She is a clerk in the supermarket.
ex.zh: 她在超市當店員。

ex.en: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
ex.zh: 湯姆想把泳衣換成大一號，但店員說不行。

clerk.en: a person who serves customers in a shop

ex.en: I'm a bank clerk.
ex.zh: 我是銀行行員。

ex.en: The hotel clerk gave us the room key.
ex.zh: 飯店櫃檯人員把房間鑰匙給了我們。

clerk.en: a person who does office work such as keeping records

ex.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
ex.zh: 她買了六碼的布來做洋裝。

ex.en: This bag is made of cotton cloth.
ex.zh: 這個袋子是用棉布做的。

cloth.en: material made from threads, used to make things people wear

ex.en: Old stuff that doesn't fit any more can be used as cloths.
ex.zh: 不合穿的舊衣服可以拿來當抹布。

ex.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 用濕抹布擦桌子。

cloth.en: a piece of material used for cleaning or wiping

ex.en: The police didn't find any clues.
ex.zh: 警方沒有找到任何線索。

ex.en: The report gives us a clue about what went wrong.
ex.zh: 這份報告給了我們出錯原因的線索。

clue.en: a piece of information that helps you solve a problem or crime

ex.en: I have no clue.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道。

ex.en: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
ex.zh: 我完全不懂他為什麼突然辭職。

clue.en: to not know anything about something

ex.en: Cats hate vacuum cleaners.
ex.zh: 貓很討厭吸塵器。

ex.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
ex.zh: 我免費拿到這台吸塵器。

ex.en: Turn off the vacuum cleaner!
ex.zh: 把吸塵器關掉！

cleaner.en: a product or machine used to remove dirt from things

ex.en: The office cleaner comes every evening at seven.
ex.zh: 辦公室清潔人員每天晚上七點來。

ex.en: We hired a cleaner to clean the apartment.
ex.zh: 我們請了清潔工來打掃公寓。

cleaner.en: a person whose job is to remove dirt from buildings

ex.en: We should classify them before throwing them out.
ex.zh: 丟掉之前，我們應該先把它們分類。

ex.en: Books in the library are classified by subject.
ex.zh: 圖書館的書是按主題分類的。

classify.en: to put things into groups of the same type

classify.zh: classified：機密的；分類廣告的（classified ad）

ex.en: The classified documents were hidden.
ex.zh: 機密檔案被藏起來了。

ex.en: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.
ex.zh: 這則分類廣告徵求女歌手組成無伴奏合唱團。

classify.en: kept secret by the government, or put under a heading in a newspaper

ex.en: The school's closure was due to the snow.
ex.zh: 學校停課是因為下雪。

ex.en: The factory closure left 200 people without jobs.
ex.zh: 工廠關閉讓兩百人失業。

ex.en: The road closure caused heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 道路封閉造成嚴重塞車。

closure.en: the act of shutting a place permanently or for a time

ex.en: Use a paper clip to keep the pages together.
ex.zh: 用迴紋針把這幾頁夾在一起。

ex.en: She wore a hair clip.
ex.zh: 她戴著一個髮夾。

clip.en: a small object used to hold things together

ex.en: Have you seen the video clip online?
ex.zh: 你看過網路上那段影片嗎？

ex.en: They showed a short clip from the movie.
ex.zh: 他們播放了電影的一小段片段。

clip.en: a short part of a film or video

ex.en: Clip the badge to your shirt.
ex.zh: 把名牌別在你的襯衫上。

ex.en: She clipped the receipts together.
ex.zh: 她把收據夾在一起。

clip.en: to fasten something to another thing with a small object

ex.en: He clipped the sheep.
ex.zh: 他幫羊剪毛。

ex.en: He clipped a coupon from the newspaper.
ex.zh: 他從報紙上剪下一張折價券。

clip.en: to cut something short, or to cut something out

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.
ex.zh: 他演講完後，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

ex.en: All the students clapped their hands.
ex.zh: 所有學生都鼓掌了。

ex.en: Tom clapped his hands.
ex.zh: 湯姆拍了手。

clap.en: to hit your hands together to show you enjoyed something

ex.en: We heard a loud clap of thunder.
ex.zh: 我們聽到一聲響雷。

ex.en: Let's give our speaker a big clap.
ex.zh: 讓我們給講者熱烈的掌聲。

clap.en: a short loud sound of hands hitting together, or of thunder

ex.en: The hotel is known for its cleanliness.
ex.zh: 這家飯店以乾淨著稱。

ex.en: Cleanliness is very important in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房的清潔非常重要。

cleanliness.en: the state of being free from dirt

ex.en: The classification of the documents took a week.
ex.zh: 文件分類花了一週。

ex.en: What is the age classification of this movie?
ex.zh: 這部電影的分級是什麼？

classification.en: the act of putting things into groups of the same type

ex.en: He is cleverer than I.
ex.zh: 他比我聰明。

ex.en: He is a clever boy, to be sure.
ex.zh: 他確實是個聰明的孩子。

ex.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
ex.zh: 他也許很聰明，但不太幫得上忙。

clever.en: quick at learning and understanding things

ex.en: What a clever idea!
ex.zh: 真是個好點子！

ex.en: This is a clever way to save space in a small kitchen.
ex.zh: 這是在小廚房裡節省空間的巧妙方法。

ex.en: Every now and then they clash over their differences.
ex.zh: 他們偶爾會因為意見不同而起衝突。

ex.en: The two managers often clash over budgets.
ex.zh: 這兩位經理常為了預算起衝突。

clash.en: to argue or fight with someone

ex.en: The meeting clashes with my dentist appointment.
ex.zh: 這場會議跟我看牙醫的時間撞期了。

ex.en: That tie clashes with your shirt.
ex.zh: 那條領帶跟你的襯衫不搭。

clash.en: to happen at the same time, or to look bad together

ex.en: There was a clash between the two departments.
ex.zh: 兩個部門之間起了衝突。

ex.en: A clash of opinions is normal in a meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時意見不合是很正常的。

ex.en: It is the students' duty to clean their classrooms.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是學生的責任。

ex.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
ex.zh: 進教室時請脫帽。

ex.en: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.
ex.zh: 老師要我們每天打掃教室。

classroom.en: a room in a school where lessons take place

ex.en: This phone is a cheap clone of a famous brand.
ex.zh: 這支手機是知名品牌的廉價山寨版。

ex.en: Scientists created a clone of the sheep.
ex.zh: 科學家複製出了那隻羊的複製體。

clone.en: an exact copy of something, or a living thing made from the cells of another

ex.en: Scientists have cloned a monkey.
ex.zh: 科學家已經複製出一隻猴子。

ex.en: First, clone the project to your computer.
ex.zh: 首先，把專案複製到你的電腦上。

clone.en: to make an exact copy of a living thing from one of its cells

ex.en: The company has a lot of clout in the industry.
ex.zh: 這家公司在業界很有影響力。

ex.en: She used her political clout to get the law passed.
ex.zh: 她運用自己的政治影響力讓法案通過。

clout.en: the power to influence people and decisions

ex.en: Please explain the plan with more clarity.
ex.zh: 請更清楚地說明這個計畫。

ex.en: The new monitor offers amazing picture clarity.
ex.zh: 新螢幕的畫面清晰度很驚人。

ex.en: Your report lacks clarity.
ex.zh: 你的報告不夠清楚明確。

clarity.en: the quality of being easy to understand or see

ex.en: A local cleric led the funeral service.
ex.zh: 當地一位神職人員主持了喪禮。

ex.en: The cleric spoke about peace and kindness.
ex.zh: 這位神職人員談到和平與仁慈。

cleric.en: a priest or other religious leader

ex.en: Would you mind closing the door?
ex.zh: 可以麻煩你把門關上嗎？

ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
ex.zh: 你知道銀行幾點關門嗎？

ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
ex.zh: 工廠下週可能會關閉。

close.en: to shut something, or to stop being open for business

ex.en: We finally closed the deal last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週終於談成了這筆交易。

ex.en: The meeting closed with a short speech.
ex.zh: 會議以一段簡短的致詞結束。

close.en: to finish something, or to complete an agreement

ex.en: Please tell me the closest station to your office.
ex.zh: 請告訴我離你辦公室最近的車站。

ex.en: A close neighbor is better than a distant relative.
ex.zh: 遠親不如近鄰。

close.en: not far away in distance or time

ex.en: Amy and I are very close friends.
ex.zh: 我和 Amy 是非常要好的朋友。

ex.en: Tom is very close to his sister.
ex.zh: Tom 和他姊姊非常親近。

close.en: knowing and liking someone very well

ex.en: My physics teacher doesn't care if I skip classes.
ex.zh: 我的物理老師不在乎我是否翹課。

ex.en: Tom said that he didn't have any classes today.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他今天沒課。

ex.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
ex.zh: 她晚上去上防身術課。

class.en: a period of time when students are taught

ex.en: Jack is the most intelligent boy in the class.
ex.zh: 傑克是班上最聰明的男孩。

ex.en: This class consists of 15 boys and 28 girls.
ex.zh: 這個班有十五個男生和二十八個女生。

class.en: a group of students who are taught together

ex.en: I usually fly economy class.
ex.zh: 我通常搭經濟艙。

ex.en: He always travels business class.
ex.zh: 他出差總是搭商務艙。

class.en: a level or type of quality, or a type of seat on a plane

ex.en: It is clear that he is a great artist.
ex.zh: 很明顯，他是個偉大的藝術家。

ex.en: Are the instructions clear?
ex.zh: 說明清楚嗎？

clear.en: easy to see, hear or understand

ex.en: On a clear day, you can see Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 天氣晴朗時可以看到富士山。

ex.en: The water in the lake is very clear.
ex.zh: 湖水非常清澈。

clear.en: bright without clouds, or see-through and clean

ex.en: She always clears the table after a meal.
ex.zh: 她總是在飯後收拾餐桌。

ex.en: Please clear your desk before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請把桌面清乾淨。

clear.en: to take away things from a place to make it empty

clear.zh: clear up：（天氣）放晴；（病情）好轉

ex.en: The sky cleared up after the ritual was over.
ex.zh: 祭典結束後，天就放晴了。

ex.en: Fortunately, my wound is clearing up quickly.
ex.zh: 還好我的傷口很快就好了。

clear.en: to become bright after rain, or to get better

ex.en: He claimed to be an expert in finance.
ex.zh: 他自稱是金融專家。

ex.en: This product claims to help you lose weight.
ex.zh: 這個產品號稱能幫你減肥。

ex.en: Tom and Mary claim that they're happy.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪莉聲稱他們很快樂。

claim.en: to say that something is true without proof

ex.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
ex.zh: 這些說法沒有科學根據。

ex.en: The company denied the claim.
ex.zh: 公司否認了這個說法。

claim.en: a statement that something is true

ex.en: She filed an insurance claim after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故後她提出了保險理賠申請。

ex.en: Claims must be made within 30 days.
ex.zh: 理賠申請必須在三十天內提出。

claim.en: a request for money from an insurance company

ex.en: You can claim your baggage at carousel 5.
ex.zh: 您可以在五號轉盤領取行李。

ex.en: No one has claimed the lost wallet.
ex.zh: 沒有人來認領那個遺失的錢包。

claim.en: to ask for and take something that belongs to you

ex.en: She speaks clearly enough to be easily understood.
ex.zh: 她說得很清楚，很容易聽懂。

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示有意降稅。

clearly.en: in a way that is easy to see, hear or understand

ex.en: Kate's voice is clearly different from the other girls'.
ex.zh: Kate 的聲音明顯和其他女孩不同。

ex.en: This drink clearly has the same flavor as tea.
ex.zh: 這個飲料的味道顯然跟茶一樣。

clearly.en: used to say that something is easy to see or know

ex.en: Do you belong to any clubs?
ex.zh: 你有參加任何社團嗎？

ex.en: Tom is no longer a member of this club.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經不是這個俱樂部的成員了。

ex.en: Mr Johnson, president of the club, will soon come.
ex.zh: 俱樂部會長 Johnson 先生很快就會到。

club.en: a group of people who meet to share an interest

ex.en: The fans all hope the club changes the manager.
ex.zh: 球迷們都希望球隊換教練。

ex.en: He signed with a new football club.
ex.zh: 他和一家新的足球俱樂部簽約。

club.en: a sports team and the organization that runs it

ex.en: He bought a new set of golf clubs.
ex.zh: 他買了一套新的高爾夫球桿。

ex.en: Which club should I use for this shot?
ex.zh: 這一桿我該用哪支球桿？

club.en: a long stick used to hit the ball in golf

ex.en: It is the students' duty to clean their classrooms.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是學生的責任。

ex.en: They cleaned everything, from the basement to the attic.
ex.zh: 他們從地下室到閣樓全都打掃了。

ex.en: I spent the whole day cleaning up the room.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天打掃房間。

ex.en: Please clean up your desk before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請把桌面整理乾淨。

clean.en: to make a place tidy by removing dirt and mess

ex.en: The air of Sydney is cleaner than that of Tokyo.
ex.zh: 雪梨的空氣比東京乾淨。

ex.en: We need not only adequate water but clean water.
ex.zh: 我們不只需要充足的水，還需要乾淨的水。

ex.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
ex.zh: 他買的第一樣東西是鬧鐘。

ex.en: There are no clocks in my room.
ex.zh: 我的房間裡沒有時鐘。

clock.en: a machine on a wall or table that shows the time

ex.en: Don't forget to clock out before you leave work.
ex.zh: 下班前別忘了打卡。

ex.en: I clocked in at 8:30 this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上八點半打卡上班。

clock.en: to record the time you arrive at or leave work

clock.zh: around the clock：日以繼夜、全天候

ex.en: The team worked around the clock to finish the project.
ex.zh: 團隊日以繼夜地趕完這個專案。

ex.en: The store is open around the clock.
ex.zh: 這家店二十四小時營業。

clock.en: all day and all night without stopping

ex.en: I was ashamed to go out in old clothes.
ex.zh: 穿舊衣服出門讓我覺得很丟臉。

ex.en: Wearing second-hand clothes is now popular among young people.
ex.zh: 穿二手衣現在在年輕人之間很流行。

ex.en: She finished ironing the clothes a few minutes ago.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘前燙完了衣服。

clothes.en: the things people wear on their bodies

ex.en: The rope broke when we were climbing the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們爬山時繩子斷了。

ex.en: With great effort he climbed up the tree.
ex.zh: 他費了好大的勁才爬上那棵樹。

climb.en: to go up something such as a hill or a ladder

ex.en: Prices have climbed steadily this year.
ex.zh: 今年物價持續上漲。

ex.en: The temperature climbed to 35 degrees.
ex.zh: 氣溫升到了 35 度。

climb.en: to go up in amount or level

ex.en: It was a long climb to the top.
ex.zh: 爬到山頂要走很長一段路。

ex.en: The company saw a steady climb in sales.
ex.zh: 公司的銷售額穩定成長。

climb.en: the act of going up, or a rise in level

ex.en: We observed this plant closely for a few weeks.
ex.zh: 我們仔細觀察這株植物好幾個星期了。

ex.en: Tom is looking closely at the map.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在仔細看地圖。

ex.en: They are watching what's happening closely.
ex.zh: 他們正密切關注事態的發展。

closely.zh: 緊密地、密切地（相關、合作）

ex.en: Dutch is closely related to German.
ex.zh: 荷蘭語和德語關係密切。

ex.en: We work closely with our suppliers.
ex.zh: 我們與供應商密切合作。

closely.en: in a way that is strongly connected

ex.en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
ex.zh: 麥根沙士被視為經典的美式碳酸飲料。

ex.en: Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.
ex.zh: 下個月也會有多款經典的闔家遊戲加入這項服務。

ex.en: That's a classic example of poor planning.
ex.zh: 這是規劃不周的典型例子。

classic.en: of high quality and lasting value, or a very typical example

ex.en: This movie is a classic.
ex.zh: 這部電影是經典之作。

ex.en: I enjoy reading the classics.
ex.zh: 我喜歡讀經典名著。

classic.en: a book, film or song that is of high quality and has lasted for a long time

ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
ex.zh: 整體來說，日本的氣候很溫和。

ex.en: Rice grows in warm climates.
ex.zh: 稻米生長在溫暖的氣候中。

ex.en: I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
ex.zh: 我正慢慢適應這裡嚴酷的氣候。

climate.en: the usual weather conditions in a place

ex.en: The current economic climate is difficult for small businesses.
ex.zh: 目前的經濟情勢對小型企業很不利。

ex.en: The new manager created a climate of trust.
ex.zh: 新經理營造出互信的氛圍。

climate.en: the general feeling or situation at a certain time

ex.en: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
ex.zh: 那朵雲是魚的形狀。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看見一朵白雲飄過天空。

cloud.en: a white or grey mass in the sky that is made of tiny drops of water

ex.en: All our files are stored in the cloud.
ex.zh: 我們所有的檔案都存在雲端。

ex.en: You can back up your photos to the cloud.
ex.zh: 你可以把照片備份到雲端。

cloud.en: a network of computers on the internet where data is stored

ex.en: The sky has gradually clouded over.
ex.zh: 天空漸漸被雲層覆蓋。

ex.en: Don't let your emotions cloud your judgment.
ex.zh: 別讓情緒影響你的判斷。

cloud.en: to hide the sky with thick grey masses, or to make something hard to understand

ex.en: Not all clinical studies are hypothesis-driven.
ex.zh: 並非所有臨床研究都是以假說為出發點。

ex.en: The new drug is in clinical trials.
ex.zh: 這種新藥正在進行臨床試驗。

ex.en: She has ten years of clinical experience.
ex.zh: 她有十年的臨床經驗。

clinical.en: relating to the study and treatment of patients

ex.en: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
ex.zh: 搖滾樂和古典音樂，你比較喜歡哪一種？

ex.en: I like classical music more than modern music.
ex.zh: 比起現代音樂，我更喜歡古典音樂。

ex.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.
ex.zh: 我空閒時總喜歡聽古典音樂。

classical.en: relating to serious music of the traditional European kind

classical.zh: 古典的、經典的（文學、建築）

ex.en: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.
ex.zh: 你應該每天背一篇古典文學作品。

ex.en: The building is a fine example of classical architecture.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是古典建築的絕佳範例。

classical.en: relating to the art and culture of ancient Greece and Rome

ex.en: Click the picture to go to the next page!
ex.zh: 點選圖片就能進入下一頁！

ex.en: Don't click on that link.
ex.zh: 不要點那個連結。

ex.en: Click the button below to download the file.
ex.zh: 點擊下方按鈕下載檔案。

click.en: to press a button on a computer mouse

ex.en: Did you hear the click?
ex.zh: 你有聽到咔噠一聲嗎？

ex.en: The ad received thousands of clicks in one day.
ex.zh: 這則廣告一天內獲得了數千次點擊。

click.en: a short sharp sound, or a press of a mouse button

ex.en: The door clicked shut.
ex.zh: 門咔噠一聲關上了。

ex.en: The lock clicked when I turned the key.
ex.zh: 我轉動鑰匙時，鎖發出咔噠一聲。

click.en: to make a short sharp sound

ex.en: You can't judge a person based on clothing.
ex.zh: 你不能根據穿著來評斷一個人。

ex.en: Tomorrow afternoon, I will be inside my mom's clothing store.
ex.zh: 明天下午我會在我媽媽的服飾店裡。

ex.en: I can provide my family with food and clothing.
ex.zh: 我能讓家人有得吃、有得穿。

clothing.en: the things people wear on their bodies

ex.en: There is a cluster of small shops near the station.
ex.zh: 車站附近有一群小商店。

ex.en: The report shows a cluster of complaints in March.
ex.zh: 報告顯示客訴集中在三月。

cluster.en: a small group of similar things close together

ex.en: People clustered around the TV to watch the game.
ex.zh: 大家聚在電視機前看比賽。

ex.en: Most of the restaurants are clustered near the station.
ex.zh: 大部分餐廳都集中在車站附近。

cluster.en: to gather closely together in a group

ex.en: Tom worked the clay into a vase.
ex.zh: 湯姆把黏土捏成了一個花瓶。

ex.en: The children made animals out of clay.
ex.zh: 孩子們用黏土做了動物。

ex.en: These bricks are made of red clay.
ex.zh: 這些磚是用紅土做的。

clay.en: soft heavy earth that becomes hard when baked, used for making pots

ex.en: They climbed to the top of a cliff.
ex.zh: 他們爬到了懸崖頂上。

ex.en: I nearly fell off the cliff.
ex.zh: 我差點從懸崖上摔下去。

ex.en: They would have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.
ex.zh: 如果車子掉下懸崖，他們早就沒命了。

cliff.en: a high steep wall of rock, usually next to the sea

ex.en: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
ex.zh: 她的英文說得比班上任何同學都好。

ex.en: How are you getting along with your new classmates?
ex.zh: 你和新同學相處得怎麼樣？

ex.en: These five books belong to my classmate.
ex.zh: 這五本書是我同學的。

classmate.en: a person who is in the same class as you at school

ex.en: I bought this jacket at a clearance sale.
ex.zh: 我在清倉拍賣時買了這件外套。

ex.en: All clearance items are final sale.
ex.zh: 所有清倉商品恕不退換。

clearance.en: a sale of goods at low prices to get rid of them

ex.en: The plane is waiting for clearance to land.
ex.zh: 飛機正在等待降落許可。

ex.en: You need security clearance to enter this building.
ex.zh: 你需要安全許可才能進入這棟大樓。

ex.en: Where is the nearest clinic?
ex.zh: 最近的診所在哪裡？

ex.en: A new health clinic is set to open next month.
ex.zh: 一家新的健康診所將於下個月開幕。

ex.en: This clinic is doing laser surgery.
ex.zh: 這家診所有做雷射手術。

clinic.en: a place where people go to get medical advice or treatment

ex.en: It's getting cloudy. It may rain soon.
ex.zh: 雲越來越多，可能快下雨了。

ex.en: They forecast it will be cloudy tomorrow.
ex.zh: 預報說明天多雲。

ex.en: This morning the weather is cloudy.
ex.zh: 今天早上天氣多雲。

cloudy.en: with a grey sky and little or no sun

ex.en: The water in the pond looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 池塘的水看起來很混濁。

ex.en: If the oil becomes cloudy, put it somewhere warm.
ex.zh: 如果油變混濁，就放到溫暖的地方。

cloudy.en: not clear, so that you cannot see through it

ex.en: This room has two closets for clothing.
ex.zh: 這個房間有兩個衣櫥。

ex.en: Tom hung his jacket in the hall closet.
ex.zh: 湯姆把夾克掛在玄關的衣櫥裡。

ex.en: The burglar shut the child in the closet.
ex.zh: 強盜把小孩關在衣櫥裡。

closet.en: a tall cupboard built into a wall for clothes

ex.en: Coming out of the closet requires tremendous courage.
ex.zh: 出櫃需要莫大的勇氣。

ex.en: They both agreed to come out of the closet to their family.
ex.zh: 他們約好一起向家人出櫃。

closet.en: to tell other people openly that you are gay, lesbian or bisexual

ex.en: The clergyman visited sick members of his church every week.
ex.zh: 那位牧師每週都去探望教會裡生病的會友。

ex.en: Her grandfather was a clergyman in a small town.
ex.zh: 她的祖父曾是小鎮上的牧師。

clergyman.en: a man who is a priest or minister in the Christian church

ex.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
ex.zh: 慧如那個簡報檔還沒傳喔？客戶在催。

ex.en: This shows they have listened to the needs of their clients.
ex.zh: 這顯示他們有傾聽客戶的需求。

ex.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
ex.zh: 律師警告他的當事人不要出庭作證，但他還是作證了。

client.en: a person who pays for services from a professional or a company

ex.en: She handles clerical tasks for the finance team.
ex.zh: 她負責財務團隊的文書工作。

ex.en: The position requires strong clerical skills.
ex.zh: 這個職位需要良好的文書處理能力。

ex.en: The restaurant has a loyal business clientele.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳擁有忠實的商務客戶群。

ex.en: The new service is designed for an international clientele.
ex.zh: 這項新服務是為國際客戶群設計的。

clientele.en: all the customers of a shop or business

ex.en: Cloud computing lets staff access files remotely.
ex.zh: 雲端運算讓員工能遠端存取檔案。

ex.en: The company moved its database to cloud computing services.
ex.zh: 公司將資料庫移轉到雲端運算服務。

cloud computing.en: the use of computers and storage on the internet instead of on your own machine

ex.en: The claimant submitted photographs with the repair estimate.
ex.zh: 索賠人提交了照片和維修估價單。

ex.en: An adjuster contacted the claimant for additional documents.
ex.zh: 理賠調查員聯絡索賠人，要求補交文件。

claimant.en: a person who asks for money or a right they think they should have

ex.en: There's a clause in the contract about late payments.
ex.zh: 合約裡有一條關於延遲付款的條款。

ex.en: We asked them to remove the cancellation clause.
ex.zh: 我們要求他們刪除取消條款。

clause.en: a separate part of a legal agreement

ex.en: There are four main types of conditional clauses.
ex.zh: 條件子句主要有四種類型。

ex.en: A relative clause gives more information about a noun.
ex.zh: 關係子句為名詞提供更多資訊。

clause.en: a group of words with a subject and a verb that forms part of a sentence

ex.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我把這件事說清楚。

ex.en: Could you clarify what you mean by "soon"?
ex.zh: 可以說明一下你說的「很快」是指多快嗎？

clarify.en: to make something easier to understand

ex.en: The child clung to her mother's hand.
ex.zh: 小孩緊抓著媽媽的手。

ex.en: Wet clothes cling to your skin in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中濕衣服會黏在皮膚上。

ex.en: He still clings to the hope of winning.
ex.zh: 他仍抱著獲勝的希望不放。

ex.en: Some people cling to old habits.
ex.zh: 有些人緊守著舊習慣。

ex.en: The clergy gathered in the church for the ceremony.
ex.zh: 神職人員聚集在教堂參加儀式。

ex.en: Several members of the clergy attended the event.
ex.zh: 幾位神職人員出席了這場活動。

ex.en: The child clutched his mother's hand in the crowd.
ex.zh: 孩子在人群中緊緊抓住媽媽的手。

ex.en: She clutched her bag and ran to the station.
ex.zh: 她緊抓著包包跑向車站。

ex.en: Press the clutch before you change gears.
ex.zh: 換檔前要先踩下離合器。

ex.en: My car's clutch is making a strange noise.
ex.zh: 我的車子離合器發出奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: Cleaning the house takes me about two hours.
ex.zh: 打掃整間房子大約要花我兩個小時。

ex.en: She hired a company to do the cleaning every week.
ex.zh: 她請了一家公司每週來打掃。

closer.zh: 更近的、更親近的（close 的比較級）

ex.en: The closer exit is on the left side of the hall.
ex.zh: 比較近的出口在大廳的左側。

ex.en: They became closer friends after working on the project together.
ex.zh: 一起做完這個專案後，他們成了更親近的朋友。

ex.en: Please come closer so I can hear you better.
ex.zh: 請靠近一點，我才聽得比較清楚。

ex.en: The storm is moving closer to the coast.
ex.zh: 暴風雨正逐漸逼近海岸。

ex.en: Clare paints landscapes in her free time.
ex.zh: 克萊爾空閒時會畫風景畫。

ex.en: I'm having lunch with Clare tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要和克萊爾吃午餐。

ex.en: The bank is closed on Sundays.
ex.zh: 銀行星期日不營業。

ex.en: Please keep the door closed to keep the room warm.
ex.zh: 請把門關著，讓房間保持溫暖。

closed.zh: 關上（close 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She closed the window because it was getting cold.
ex.zh: 天氣變冷，所以她把窗戶關上了。

ex.en: The store closed early because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 那間店因颱風提早打烊。

ex.en: The committee held a closed meeting to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 委員會召開了一場不公開的會議來討論預算。

ex.en: The case was decided in a closed hearing.
ex.zh: 這個案件是在不公開的聽證會上裁定的。

ex.en: Clark is a common surname in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 克拉克是英語系國家常見的姓氏。

ex.en: In the cartoon, Clark is a reporter at a newspaper.
ex.zh: 在這部卡通裡，克拉克是報社的記者。

ex.en: Cleveland is a city in the state of Ohio.
ex.zh: 克利夫蘭是俄亥俄州的一座城市。

ex.en: Cleveland sits on the shore of Lake Erie.
ex.zh: 克利夫蘭位於伊利湖畔。

ex.en: Where is the closest train station?
ex.zh: 最近的火車站在哪裡？

ex.en: She is my closest friend, and we talk every day.
ex.zh: 她是我最親近的朋友，我們每天都聊天。

ex.en: Each clan in the village had its own traditions.
ex.zh: 村裡的每個氏族都有自己的傳統。

ex.en: The whole clan gathers for a big dinner during the New Year.
ex.zh: 整個家族在新年時會聚在一起吃大餐。

closing.zh: 關閉、關門（close 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The shop is closing in ten minutes, so hurry up.
ex.zh: 這家店十分鐘後就要關門了，快一點。

ex.en: She was closing the window when it started to rain.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時，她正在關窗。

ex.en: The closing of the festival was marked by a big fireworks show.
ex.zh: 音樂節以盛大的煙火秀劃下句點。

ex.en: We watched the closing of the old factory with sadness.
ex.zh: 我們傷感地看著那間老工廠結束營業。

ex.en: The singer performed a song in the closing ceremony.
ex.zh: 歌手在閉幕典禮上演唱了一首歌。

ex.en: In his closing remarks, he thanked everyone for coming.
ex.zh: 在他的結語中，他感謝大家的到來。

ex.en: The cleanup after the party took us three hours.
ex.zh: 派對後的清理花了我們三小時。

ex.en: Volunteers organized a beach cleanup on Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 志工在週日早上舉辦了海灘清潔活動。

ex.en: The cook added a clove of garlic to the soup.
ex.zh: 廚師在湯裡加了一瓣大蒜。

ex.en: Cloves are a strong spice often used in desserts and teas.
ex.zh: 丁香是一種味道濃烈的香料，常用在甜點和茶裡。

ex.en: Crush two cloves of garlic and fry them in oil.
ex.zh: 把兩瓣大蒜壓碎，用油煎香。

ex.en: The climber reached the top of the mountain before noon.
ex.zh: 登山者在中午前登上了山頂。

ex.en: A group of climbers set up camp near the base of the cliff.
ex.zh: 一群登山客在峭壁底部附近紮營。

ex.en: The knight wore a long black cloak.
ex.zh: 那位騎士穿著一件黑色長斗篷。

ex.en: She wrapped her cloak tightly against the cold wind.
ex.zh: 她把斗篷裹緊以抵擋寒風。

ex.en: Fog cloaked the mountains in the early morning.
ex.zh: 清晨的霧籠罩著群山。

ex.en: The company cloaked its plans in secrecy.
ex.zh: 這間公司把計畫掩藏在保密之中。

ex.en: Rock climbing is her favorite weekend activity.
ex.zh: 攀岩是她最愛的週末活動。

ex.en: He took up climbing after moving to the mountains.
ex.zh: 他搬到山區後開始爬山。

ex.en: The boys are climbing the tree behind the house.
ex.zh: 男孩們正在爬房子後面的那棵樹。

ex.en: She is climbing the stairs with a heavy bag.
ex.zh: 她提著重重的袋子爬樓梯。

climbing.zh: 上升；攀升（climb 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Prices are climbing every month.
ex.zh: 物價每個月都在攀升。

ex.en: The temperature keeps climbing as noon approaches.
ex.zh: 接近中午時，氣溫持續上升。

ex.en: The clown made balloon animals for the children at the party.
ex.zh: 小丑在派對上為孩子們做氣球動物。

ex.en: My little sister is afraid of clowns with big red noses.
ex.zh: 我妹妹很怕有著紅色大鼻子的小丑。

ex.en: He is the class clown who always makes everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他是班上的開心果，總是把大家逗笑。

ex.en: Stop acting like a clown and listen to the teacher.
ex.zh: 別再耍寶了，好好聽老師說話。

ex.en: He is clearing the snow from the driveway.
ex.zh: 他正在清除車道上的積雪。

ex.en: She spent the morning clearing out the garage.
ex.zh: 她花了一個早上清理車庫。

ex.en: We set up our tent in a small clearing in the woods.
ex.zh: 我們在樹林中的一小塊空地搭起帳篷。

ex.en: A deer stood in the clearing at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明時，一隻鹿站在那片空地上。

ex.en: The cat sank its claws into the sofa.
ex.zh: 貓把爪子扎進沙發裡。

ex.en: A crab uses its big claw to catch food.
ex.zh: 螃蟹用牠的大螯夾取食物。

ex.en: The kitten clawed at the curtain.
ex.zh: 小貓用爪子抓扯窗簾。

ex.en: He clawed his way up the muddy slope.
ex.zh: 他手腳並用地爬上泥濘的斜坡。

ex.en: The climax of the movie is a thrilling chase through the city.
ex.zh: 這部電影的高潮是一場穿越城市的驚險追逐。

ex.en: The concert reached its climax when the whole crowd began to sing.
ex.zh: 當全場觀眾開始合唱時，演唱會到達了高潮。

ex.en: The story climaxes with a dramatic rescue at sea.
ex.zh: 故事在一場戲劇性的海上救援中達到高潮。

ex.en: The festival climaxed with a huge show of fireworks.
ex.zh: 慶典在盛大的煙火秀中達到最高潮。

ex.en: She clasped her mother's hand tightly.
ex.zh: 她緊緊握住媽媽的手。

ex.en: He clasped the necklace around her neck.
ex.zh: 他把項鍊扣在她的脖子上。

ex.en: The clasp on my bracelet is broken.
ex.zh: 我手鍊上的扣環壞了。

ex.en: She fixed the clasp of her bag.
ex.zh: 她修好了包包的扣環。

ex.en: A clump of grass grew between the stones.
ex.zh: 石頭之間長出一叢草。

ex.en: She pulled a clump of hair out of the drain.
ex.zh: 她從排水孔裡拉出一團頭髮。

ex.en: He used a clamp to hold the board while the glue dried.
ex.zh: 他用夾鉗固定木板，等膠水乾。

ex.en: The workshop has several metal clamps on the wall.
ex.zh: 工作坊的牆上掛著好幾支金屬夾鉗。

ex.en: She clamped her hand over her mouth to stop from laughing.
ex.zh: 她用手緊緊摀住嘴巴，免得笑出來。

ex.en: Clamp the two pieces together until the glue sets.
ex.zh: 把這兩塊夾緊，直到膠水凝固。

ex.en: He clenched his fists and tried to stay calm.
ex.zh: 他握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。

ex.en: She clenched her teeth against the pain.
ex.zh: 她咬緊牙關忍痛。

ex.en: After the match, the players relaxed in the clubhouse.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，球員在會所裡放鬆休息。

ex.en: The golf clubhouse has a nice restaurant.
ex.zh: 高爾夫俱樂部會所裡有一間不錯的餐廳。

ex.en: I'm so clumsy that I dropped the plate again.
ex.zh: 我笨手笨腳，又把盤子摔了。

ex.en: The clumsy waiter spilled soup on the table.
ex.zh: 那位笨手笨腳的服務生把湯灑在桌上。

ex.en: His clumsy attempt to apologize made things worse.
ex.zh: 他笨拙的道歉反而讓事情更糟。

ex.en: The documents were classified and kept in a safe.
ex.zh: 這些文件是機密，被鎖在保險箱裡。

ex.en: He was not allowed to share classified information.
ex.zh: 他不被允許洩漏機密資訊。

ex.en: The library keeps a classified list of all its books.
ex.zh: 圖書館有一份所有書籍的分類目錄。

ex.en: Classified items are stored on different shelves.
ex.zh: 分類好的物品放在不同的架子上。

ex.en: I found my apartment through the classifieds.
ex.zh: 我是透過分類廣告找到公寓的。

ex.en: She placed a classified ad to sell her bike.
ex.zh: 她刊登了一則分類廣告來賣腳踏車。

ex.en: "Time heals all wounds" is a well-known cliche.
ex.zh: 「時間能治癒一切傷痛」是個眾所周知的陳腔濫調。

ex.en: The movie was full of every cliche in the book.
ex.zh: 這部電影充滿了各種老套的橋段。

ex.en: The ending of the story felt cliche.
ex.zh: 故事的結局感覺很老套。

ex.en: His speech was dull and cliche.
ex.zh: 他的演說既乏味又陳腐。

ex.en: I need some clarification about the new rules.
ex.zh: 我需要有人對新規定做些說明。

ex.en: The company issued a clarification after the confusing news report.
ex.zh: 在那則令人混淆的新聞報導之後，公司發出了澄清聲明。

ex.en: The team clinched the title with a win on Sunday.
ex.zh: 這支球隊靠週日那場勝利拿下了冠軍。

ex.en: She finally clinched the deal after a long meeting.
ex.zh: 經過一場冗長的會議後，她終於談成了這筆交易。

ex.en: The two boxers clinched in the middle of the ring.
ex.zh: 兩名拳擊手在擂台中央互相緊抱。

ex.en: He clinched his fists and tried to stay calm.
ex.zh: 他握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。

ex.en: Cloning animals raises many ethical questions.
ex.zh: 複製動物引發許多倫理問題。

ex.en: The scientist gave a talk about gene cloning in plants.
ex.zh: 那位科學家發表了一場關於植物基因複製的演講。

ex.en: Hair can clog the bathroom drain.
ex.zh: 頭髮會堵住浴室的排水孔。

ex.en: Heavy traffic clogged the streets after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，車潮塞滿了街道。

ex.en: She bought a pair of wooden clogs in the Netherlands.
ex.zh: 她在荷蘭買了一雙木鞋。

ex.en: The nurse wore comfortable clogs during her long shift.
ex.zh: 護理師在漫長的班次中穿著舒適的厚底鞋。

ex.en: She uses a gentle cleansing oil to remove makeup.
ex.zh: 她用溫和的卸妝油來卸妝。

ex.en: A cleansing breath helps me relax before speaking.
ex.zh: 在發言前深呼吸能幫助我放鬆。

cleansing.zh: 清潔；淨化（cleanse 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is cleansing her face before going to bed.
ex.zh: 她睡前正在清潔臉部。

ex.en: The nurse was cleansing the wound carefully.
ex.zh: 護理師正小心地清潔傷口。

ex.en: Parents must feed and clothe their children.
ex.zh: 父母必須讓孩子吃飽穿暖。

ex.en: The charity helps clothe homeless families in winter.
ex.zh: 這個慈善團體在冬天幫助無家可歸的家庭添衣。

ex.en: She was clothed in a long red coat.
ex.zh: 她身穿一件紅色長大衣。
